title: Fandom may intensify disappointment when expected cooperation is missing
claim: Positive feelings toward the series do not guarantee approval of this installment. Among non-recommended reviews praising the franchise, negative comparisons with earlier games are particularly common. The evidence raises a question about expectations for communication, shared problem-solving and the series identity, rather than proving why those players rejected the game.
basis: Start with Anticipation & fandom sentiment split by recommendation. Select Not recommended + Positive; compare with negative Series comparison, then inspect all matching original reviews and highlighted passages.
